title: Influence of feedstock powder on microstructure and mechanical properties of Ta cold spray depositions
InformationInFigures: Yes. Some D values (Fig. 2), Grain size (Fig. 7), Thickness (Fig. 8), Porosity (Fig. 9), Hardness (Fig. 11)

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: very irregular shape, porous powder with inter-granular interspace observed
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: ground by fine abrasive paper, cleaned with alcohol, and then sandblasted using SiO2 grit under the same condition. The surface roughness of the sandblasted specimen is 5.34 ± 0.09 μm

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: Nozzle throat was 2 mm x 3 mm and the exit was 2 mm x 20 mm.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: similar surface topography including bulge and little sunken. initial pores remained on the top surface. evidence of adiabatic shear instability, by evidence of particle jetting. coating composition: 91.28 wt% Ta, 2.20 wt% O, 6.51 wt% C. uniform section, and subsequent particles could be deposited. splat boundaries indistinguishable.
